source.title: Fantasy Football Sleepers 2026: Keaton Mitchell, Jaydon Blue among Rotoworld staff picks
source.author: Rotoworld Staff
source.summary: Staff sleeper selections emphasizing opportunity and value relative to current draft position.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Montgomery can command close to a workhorse share in Houston because the incumbent backs have not established trusted passing-down roles.
takeaways.rationale: Montgomery can command close to a workhorse share in Houston because the incumbent backs have not established trusted passing-down roles.
risks: Woody Marks will still have a role and an 80-percent snap projection is aggressive.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Mitchell's explosive career efficiency and expected passing-game use fit Mike McDaniel's offense and can create a PPR floor behind Hampton.
takeaways.rationale: Mitchell's explosive career efficiency and expected passing-game use fit Mike McDaniel's offense and can create a PPR floor behind Hampton.
risks: His NFL workload remains a small sample and he may stay a clear backup.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Downs can expand beyond a slot-only role amid Indianapolis' thin healthy receiver group, and Keenan Allen need not block his full route tree.
takeaways.rationale: Downs can expand beyond a slot-only role amid Indianapolis' thin healthy receiver group, and Keenan Allen need not block his full route tree.
risks: Allen and Tyler Warren still compete for underneath targets.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Irving already produced as a top-20 PPR back while hurt and can beat cost by pairing his 2024 efficiency with his 2025 workload.
takeaways.rationale: Irving already produced as a top-20 PPR back while hurt and can beat cost by pairing his 2024 efficiency with his 2025 workload.
risks: His 2025 inefficiency and injury history remain concerns.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Concepcion can lead Cleveland in receptions because he can win at multiple depths and adapt to either likely quarterback style.
takeaways.rationale: Concepcion can lead Cleveland in receptions because he can win at multiple depths and adapt to either likely quarterback style.
risks: Cleveland's quarterback quality creates a low offensive floor.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Pittman's short-area reliability fits a pass-heavier Pittsburgh offense and can produce steady PPR volume immediately.
takeaways.rationale: Pittman's short-area reliability fits a pass-heavier Pittsburgh offense and can produce steady PPR volume immediately.
risks: The role may be useful rather than high-ceiling.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Blue still has a plausible path to Dallas' third-down role and could become a cheap PPR specialist in a pass-heavy offense.
takeaways.rationale: Blue still has a plausible path to Dallas' third-down role and could become a cheap PPR specialist in a pass-heavy offense.
risks: He contributed almost nothing as a rookie and camp praise may not translate.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Robinson brings consecutive 140-target seasons into a familiar Brian Daboll system and is priced as a WR4 after a WR2 PPR finish.
takeaways.rationale: Robinson brings consecutive 140-target seasons into a familiar Brian Daboll system and is priced as a WR4 after a WR2 PPR finish.
risks: Tennessee's overall passing ceiling is uncertain.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Goedert should remain a top-12 candidate because Philadelphia lost major target volume and did not add proven competition.
takeaways.rationale: Goedert should remain a top-12 candidate because Philadelphia lost major target volume and did not add proven competition.
risks: His 11-touchdown season is unlikely to repeat.
